verses.text: Ayik tzex b'at owal, manh hex xiw t'a heb' heyajk'o'ol chi. Wach'chom tzeyila' to ek'to sb'isul heb' t'ayex, niwanpax sb'isul nok' schej heb' yet' scarruaje heb' yik owal yet' soldado heb', manh hex xiwok yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ik'jinak honh elta t'a Egipto, ha' ol och heyet'ok.
Ayik manto k'och yora'il yoch owal chi', ha winh sacerdote tz'alan t'a heb' soldado icha tik:
Ab'ek hex wetchonhab', ha tikne'ik toxo ol heyak' owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol, manh hex xiwok. Manh hex ib'xokk'e yuj xiwelal,
yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok. Ha ol ak'an owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol chi', yuj chi' ol kak' ganar heb', xcham winh.

Slajwi chi', syalan heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: Tato ay junok hex toto ix he b'ok'e he pat, manto hex ochlaj t'a yo'ol, meltzajanhek, k'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach skajnajkan t'a yol he pat chi'.
Tato ay pax junok mach t'a ko kal tik ix yawej yuwa, manta jab'ok sat smolo', meltzajokab' t'a spat. K'inalok scham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxo mach smolan sat yuwa chi'.
Tato ay junok hex ayxo he trato he nupnaji, palta manto hex nupnajok, meltzajanhek yik tzex nupnaji. K'inalok tzex cham t'a skal owal tik, ch'okxopax mach snupnaj yet' ix ix chi', xcham heb'.
Slajwi chi' syalanpax heb' yajalil soldado chi': Tato ayex tzex xiwi, meltzajanhek t'a he pat, yik wach' malaj heb' schab'axk'e sk'o'ol heyu'uj, xcham heb'.
Ayik slajwi slolon masanil heb' yajal chi', tz'ak'ji'och yopisio junjun kuchb'um t'a junjun makan heb' soldado.
Tato tzex k'och t'a spatiktak junok chonhab' yik tzeyak'an owal yet'ok, b'ab'el tzeyala': ¿He gana am junk'olal, mato owal? xe chi.
Tato ha heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' snib'ej junk'olal, tzex scha'anoch heb' t'a yol schonhab' chi', yowalil tzeyak' pural heb' yochkan he chekab'ok.
Palta tato malaj snib'ej heb' yoch junk'olal heyet'ok jun, tato syal heb': Kak'ek owal, tato xchi heb', tzex oymaj t'a spatiktak schonhab' heb' chi', tzeyak'an owal.
Haxo Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'anoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he xikancham masanil heb' winh winak.

Haxonhej heb' ix ix yet' heb' unin, nok' molb'etzal nok' yet' masanil tas ay t'a jun chonhab' chi', heyik tz'ajkani. Tzex tzalaj yet' masanil tastak ol scha sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal yik skan t'a yol he k'ab', haton masanil tas ol heyik' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ichanhej chi' ol he k'ulej yet' juntzanh nación najat ay b'aj ol hex kajnaj chi'.
Palta ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a lum lum ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal heyikej, manhxa junok anima tzeyaktejkani.
Ol he satel juntzanh heb' tik: Eb' hitita, heb' amorreo, heb' cananeo, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo, icha wal ajnak yalan Jehová.

Icha chi' tzeyutej heb', yik wach' max hex sk'ayb'ej heb' he b'eyb'alan juntzanh tas te chuk sk'ulej ayik syak'anem sb'a heb' t'a diosal. Tato tze k'ulej tas sk'ulej heb' chi', tz'och he mul t'a Jehová ko Diosal.

Tato niwan tiempo tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak junok chonhab', manh he ch'akel te te' sloji sat, yujto ol he lo sat te'. Ha te' awb'en te' chi', manh anima'ok te', max yal-laj skot te' t'ayex yak' owal heyet'ok.
Ha pax te' komon te' max loji sat jun, tze ch'akel te' yik tz'och te' he tek'nub'ok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', masanto satel jun chonhab' chi' heyu'uj.
